set.reason: Removing a coefficient-bearing bracket is distributive multiplication of each term, including a negative coefficient.
The target contains brackets whose enclosed signs and coefficients must be distributed correctly.
The stated bracket-removal procedure ends in solving the reduced linear equation; only that solving component of the prerequisite is required.

The target finds a scalar difference from 90 or 180 and distinguishes the two sum relations. It does not require the broader geometric angle-composition/bisector repertoire; Gemini conflates elementary subtraction of measures with that whole procedure.
set.scope: Angle-composition and bisection experience supporting complements and supplements

set.reason: The reduction and back-substitution leave one-variable linear equations that must be solved; this is not a claim that every route must name transposition.
The acute/right/obtuse classification uses angle size and degree units, including the ninety- and one-hundred-eighty-degree thresholds.

Fraction division prepares ratio values with fractional terms. The target expressly permits a simple ratio, and a whole-number pair such as 6 to 3 needs only ordinary division; no fraction-by-fraction division is universal.
